Image 2 is the NEW geometry authority: reconstruct this exact cabinet depth, compact true L tabletop, three exterior END chairs and their orientation. Use its elevated diagonal camera, but frame the whole cabinet, fridge, all chair feet, and full tabletop without cropping.
Image 3 is the NEW exact plan authority, cabinet on right. Copy furniture relationships, never copy its labels or diagram colors.

The sideboard door fronts and counter leading edge are aligned with the adjacent refrigerator DOOR face. The cabinet must visibly stop looking shallower than the fridge. Two tall ordinary vertical refrigerator doors at the living end, outside L, no four-door or concealed built-in replacement. Cabinet above and below are opaque warm-white. No glass cabinet doors. Preserve the four-stage structure: 880mm base, 600mm-high walnut-back open work niche, 250mm closed thin walnut flap band, top cupboards meeting ceiling via a closed finish strip. Three horizontal drawers at the far right. No black empty slot or imaginary daily storage above the refrigerator; a quiet removable light-colour louver finish as shown.

Layout update:
Three chairs only, all OUTSIDE L. Two chairs sit side-by-side at the living-facing OUTER END of the cross arm, both looking toward the kitchen, matching the two far-left backs in Image 2. One navy chair sits at the kitchen-facing FREE END, facing those two. NO chair in the notch/inner retrieval space between cabinet and L. NO chair along the long outside walkway edge. Do NOT restore Image1's two chairs inside L. Spare fourth chair offscene.
True single-piece compact L shape, not a big rectangular table: shape in mm (u along wall living->kitchen, v from wall into room): (1600,650),(2050,650),(2050,1400),(2400,1400),(2400,2000),(1600,2000). Do not enlarge room or tabletop.

Appearance:
Natural modern Japanese, clean warm white rather than yellow, pale oak with believable grain and plank joints, walnut recesses and chair frames, two sage woven seats plus one muted navy woven seat, light neutral woven chair backs. Keep limited coffee machine and two cups. Real photography quality, soft daylight with window-direction shadows, fabric weave, subtle contact shadows, balanced highlights. No cartoon outlines or plastic uniform materials.
Lighting:
LEFT OFF: all artificial lights off, daylight stays on; paper pendant physically remains but is unlit, cabinet strip unlit.
RIGHT ON: identical daylight/camera/furniture, warm white niche lighting and glowing diffuse paper pendant on. Lamps never disappear between panels. No artificial coloured light, no extra floor lamps or new furniture.
Output one wide clean diptych, small OFF / ON markers in top corners only, no dimension labels, no extra captions, no watermark. This is an independent furniture concept, not a new house layout.
